title: Organize Root Test and Fix Files into tests/
instructions: Move all old files, test files, fix scripts, and development utility scripts from the repository root into the tests/ directory to clean up the project structure while preserving files for reference or future use.

1785363770.4582896.instruction: Check current directory structure to understand project layout and existing configuration files

1785363770.4584122.instruction: Verify if .github/workflows directory exists and check for any existing workflow files

1785363770.4593892.instruction: Look for requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.py or similar dependency configuration files

1785363770.459488.instruction: Create .github/workflows directory structure if it doesn't exist

1785363770.4596882.instruction: Validate the created workflow file syntax and structure

1785620193.2160444.instruction: Scan the repository root and identify all files that are test-related, fix scripts, old versions, or development utilities. Categorize them into groups: root test files (test_*.py), fix scripts (fix_*.py), add/extract/verify/write/run/check scripts, and old baseline files (commands_*.py).

1785620193.2162967.instruction: Inside tests/, create subdirectories to organize the moved files: tests/legacy/ for old/baseline files, tests/fix_scripts/ for fix scripts, and tests/dev_scripts/ for development utilities. Ensure these directories exist before moving files.

1785620193.254762.instruction: Move all test_*.py files currently in the repository root into the tests/ directory. These are standalone test files that belong with the rest of the test suite.

1785620193.2549503.instruction: Move all fix_*.py files from the repository root into tests/fix_scripts/. These are temporary repair scripts kept for reference.

1785620193.2551177.instruction: Move development utility scripts (add_*.py, extract_*.py, verify_*.py, write_*.py, run_*.py, check_*.py, integrate_sort_engine.py, register_batch_update.py, replace_binlog_calls.py, apply_async_binlog.py, modify_log_binlog.py, move_remaining_md.py, organize_files.py, final_validation.py) from root into tests/dev_scripts/.

1785620193.2552686.instruction: Move old command baseline files (commands_8e234ac.py, commands_baseline.py) from root into tests/legacy/. These are historical snapshots not part of the active codebase.

1785620193.2554135.instruction: After moving files, check that no active source files import from the moved scripts. If any imports are broken, either update them to point to the new location or confirm the moved files are not actively used.

1785620193.2555745.instruction: Update docs/TESTING.md or README.md if needed to mention the new organization of test, fix, and development scripts. Keep changes minimal.

1785620193.2557285.instruction: List the repository root and tests/ directory to confirm files were moved correctly. Provide a summary of what was moved and where.
